title: Chemistry of a newly detected circumbinary disk in Ophiuchus
question: Is there a circumbinary disk around the Class I proto-binary Oph-IRS67AB, and what are its kinematics, chemistry, mass and temperature structure?

data.sensitivity: continuum rms 0.4 mJy/beam; 10 mJy/beam per channel

evidence.quote: in this paper, we adopt the latter.
relative to the system velocity ($V_{\rm LSR}$) of 4.2 km s$^{-1}$ (cite: Lindberg2017)

recipe.goal: Measure continuum structure and source positions
recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fits to both peaks; deconvolved size of disk-like structure; inclination from toy thin circular model
assumptions: Thin circular structure gives inclination ~80 deg

recipe.goal: Moment maps, spectra and channel maps of lines
recipe.method: Moment 0/1 maps; spectra extracted over 1 pixel (0.1''x0.1''); channel maps; two-component Gaussian for SO2
Peak emission per channel via imfit; fit v∝r^-0.5 and v∝r^-1 to points >1.7 km/s along PA=234 deg
key_parameters: Centre at geometric centre; inclination 80 deg

recipe.goal: Derive dust and gas masses and CO abundance
recipe.method: Optically thin dust mass from 0.87 mm flux; gas mass from C17O 3-2 integrated intensity; CO abundance by inverting gas-mass equation with gas-to-dust 100
key_parameters: C17O integrated over 20 km/s, 5.31 ± 0.01 Jy km/s above 5 sigma
assumptions: Dust T=30 K, Ossenkopf & Henning opacity, gas-to-dust 100, C17O/CO=4.5e-4 and CO/H2=2.7e-4

recipe.goal: Estimate optical depth, column densities and abundances
recipe.method: Non-LTE RADEX at source B, n(H2)=1e7 cm-3, Tkin=30 and 100 K, b=FWHM; abundance ratios vs CO compared with IRAS 16293

evidence.quote: The separation between sources A and B is 0.71$''$ $\pm$ 0.01$''$ (107 $\pm$ 2 AU).
the central mass associated with the infalling fit is 3.6 $\pm$ 0.3 M$_{\odot}$
a value of 1.1 $\times$ 10$^{-2}$ *M$_{\odot}$* is obtained for the total mass
a dust mass of 1.1 $\times$ 10$^{-4}$ *M$_{\odot}$* is derived

not_stated_but_needed: CASA version and whether pipeline or manual calibration
Imaging parameters: weighting/robust, cell and image size, deconvolver, masks
Continuum subtraction method and line-free channels
Whether spws were combined across the four sessions
Flux calibration uncertainty and any self-calibration
Velocity ranges for moment maps and clipping thresholds
Uncertainty and weighting details of the imfit peak-position PV fits
RADEX setup details beyond density, Tkin, and b
Dust temperature adopted for the 30 K versus 100 K masses (continuum flux used for mass)
score_reason: Data public and analysis simple, but imaging and fitting settings are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data and numeric results such as continuum fluxes and central mass, though imaging details must be chosen.
